cs.t: The Breville stuff is complete garbage.  Bought a expresso machine a few years ago, crapped within 1 year, William Sonoma gave a new one, crapped again, I fix it with parts from eBay, then craps again. Unsealed shit switches in a humid environment, no conformal coating on PCB.  Not even real FR4, a cheap cardboard laminate found in chineseium toys. Fancy stainless on the outside, garbage on the inside.
